verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a SaaS phone service, but the pack documents no Google Voice API. All of the Voice capabilities shown (porting, ring groups, auto attendants, desk phones) are described only as Admin console or UI workflows. The one API reference is the generic Workspace Admin Reports activities endpoint, which is not Voice-specific and offers no evidence of a Voice API matching the UI. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
